text.cn: 银行卡突然失灵，你只剩机场换的现金。摊主摇头：最好转微信。路边有鸡爪、臭豆腐、鸭血粉丝——翻译写着「Chicken Feet of Happiness」。
text.en: Your bank card dies. Only airport cash left. Vendors want WeChat. Menus say "Chicken Feet of Happiness" next to stinky tofu and duck-blood soup.

text.cn: 找留学生帮忙：现金换支付宝余额（小额手续费）。
text.en: Ask a student to cash→Alipay top-up (small fee).

feedback.cn: 你学会了中国式「找人代充」。信任与尴尬并存。
feedback.en: You learn Chinese-style peer top-up. Trust and awkwardness coexist.

text.cn: 硬吃鸡爪 + 臭豆腐，当文化体验。
text.en: Eat chicken feet + stinky tofu as culture.

feedback.cn: 味道像挑战书。你活下来了，口腔记忆永久。
feedback.en: Taste like a dare. You survive with permanent oral memory.

text.cn: 点路边摊炒粉——没人说里面有花生碎。
text.en: Order street noodles — nobody mentions peanut bits.

feedback.cn: 过敏发作。急诊 + 打针。钱与 Sanity 双双蒸发。
feedback.en: Allergic reaction. ER + shot. Money and sanity both melt.

text.cn: 改坐秦淮河画舫，避开食物轮盘。
text.en: Take a Qinhuai boat; skip food roulette.

feedback.cn: 灯影里的秦淮很美。肚子空，眼睛饱。
feedback.en: Lanterns on the river. Empty stomach, full eyes.
